tasks.short: Consult professionals about actual patient neurological conditions.

steps.what: Review actual patient findings and source records relevant to the professional consultation
Consult other professionals about actual neurological findings, uncertainties and needed care
Write and check actual consultation findings, qualifications and agreed next actions
Save the checked actual professional consultation note

tasks.design: Configure a native dated findings view in {OTHER}, the clinical record system, retaining actual source reading. Keep professional consultation and fresh outcome writing human; separately save the actual checked note without adding a consultation report or treating discussion as a completed referral.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant clinical findings may require separate record navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native related-record views can shorten navigation without summarising or interpreting patient conditions.
tasks.still_hard: Clinical uncertainty and conflicting professional interpretations require direct discussion.
tasks.human_edge: The neuropsychologist explains the meaning and limits of actual findings.
tasks.altitude: Less navigation; clinical authority and professional accountability are unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: clinical record systems can show dated source findings in a native patient view.

assumptions: Boundary is this clinicians preparation, actual consultation and short outcome note. Other professionals labour is not reduced or counted as focal saving.

Prior actual clinical work supplies patient ID, dated findings, source author and record references. The clinician selects and verifies them in s1; missing records require manual retrieval within its retained effort.
No consultation transcript, structured outcome or extra report is assumed. Actual conclusions arise only in s2 and are captured in s3.

Shares are provisional. Native configuration is tested first; existing views earn no saving. The note accuracy check is ordinary capture work and covers the fully retained 1 percent save, which is schema granularity.
research_questions: Does the existing record system expose the required dated findings without new tooling?

incremental.description: Check findings-view source links and access changes

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete checked actual consultation note for the identified patient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional ten-unit record navigation at 50 percent saves five points minus 0.5 upkeep = 4.5. Half eligible navigation gives two. Actual consultation, outcome writing and save retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Keep current through neuropsychology literature, colleagues and professional participation.

steps.what: Find current neuropsychology literature using selected native library searches and alerts
Read current literature and evaluate methods, clinical claims and evidence limits
Talk with colleagues about actual research findings and clinical uncertainties
Participate in professional organisations or conferences and question new claims
Write and check personal research notes, source references and unresolved questions
Save the checked personal learning notes

tasks.design: Configure native topic searches and current-issue alerts in {OTHER}, the licensed research library. Keep actual literature reading, colleague conversations and professional participation intact; separately write, check and save personal notes in {DOCS} without substituting generated summaries for reading.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding new papers may repeat manual journal and topic searches.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved searches can expose current records while leaving selection and critical reading human.
tasks.still_hard: A relevant abstract does not establish credible or clinically applicable evidence.
tasks.human_edge: The clinician relates actual methods and findings to patient care and professional debate.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated searching; research interpretation and participation remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: research libraries support native saved topic searches and current-issue alerts.

assumptions: Boundary is keeping current through literature and professional exchange, including short actual personal notes. No paper appraisal or conference participation is automated.

The clinician supplies topic terms and inclusion interests within s1; library publishers supply indexed records. Missing metadata and overly broad results require manual selection within retained s1 time.
Native searches precede custom screening. Existing alerts earn no benefit and literature reading retains full effort.
Shares are provisional. The existing note accuracy check covers its save; the fully retained 1 percent save is schema granularity, not added approval ceremony.
unknowns: Library coverage of relevant neuropsychology sources
research_questions: Do native searches expose relevant current records without replacing critical reading?

incremental.description: Refresh selected topic searches and prune irrelevant alerts

approvals.approved_version: s5 complete checked personal learning notes and source references

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional 15-unit repeated searching at 60 percent reduction saves nine points minus 0.5 upkeep = 8.5. Half eligible searching gives four. Reading, discussions, participation, actual notes and save remain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Diagnose and treat psychiatric conditions using actual clinical evidence.

steps.what: Assess actual patient history, symptoms, functioning and relevant clinical evidence
Diagnose the condition and determine appropriate treatment within actual clinical authority
Treat the patient and adapt the clinical interaction to actual response and needs
Dictate, write and correct the actual assessment, diagnosis and treatment outcome note

loop.purpose: Format the clinicians post-session dictation as a clinical note
loop.input: Clinician dictation of actual findings, chosen diagnosis, treatment and observed response
loop.output: Draft clinical note preserving clinician statements and uncertainty
loop.check: Clinician verifies diagnosis attribution, negation, actual versus planned care, omissions and unsupported implications against their own findings; corrects every material error
loop.stop: Missing clinician statement, ambiguity or two failed corrections returns to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native clinical template is used first; free-form post-session dictation still needs reviewed language formatting

steps.what: Save the checked actual clinical note

tasks.design: Keep actual assessment, diagnosis and treatment human. Test the native note form in {OTHER}, the clinical record system, before bounded post-session dictation formatting; count dictation and semantic correction in the writing step, then save the actual checked note separately without any model diagnosis or treatment recommendation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing the clinicians actual session findings can require repeated prose entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Reviewed speech-driven clinical reporting is available, but its relevance depends on actual dictation and correction effort.
tasks.still_hard: Patient assessment, psychiatric diagnosis and response-based treatment require clinical responsibility.
tasks.human_edge: The clinician forms and revises the diagnosis through actual patient contact and evidence.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less note entry; clinical authority and treatment time are unchanged.

evidence.claim: Speech-driven reporting is in use in Dutch mental health care; this supports clinical documentation capability, not automated diagnosis or a local saving figure.

assumptions: Boundary is actual assessment, diagnosis, treatment and the clinicians own session note. Prescribing outside this professions actual authority and other clinicians work are not added.

The clinician produces actual findings and decisions in s1-s3 and supplies post-session dictation in s4. Dictation, corrections and the existing final note accuracy check are all included in s4 retained time; no transcript or structured note is free.

Use only a permitted clinical environment with established access. No model selects diagnoses, evaluates the patient or changes treatment. Native forms are tested first; already deployed dictation yields no new benefit.
Shares and reduction are provisional. The separate save is fully retained 1 percent schema granularity and does not add self-approval work.
unknowns: Actual note-writing share and correction effort
research_questions: Does actual post-session dictation plus correction reduce entry while preserving every clinical qualification?

already_counted.description: Post-session dictation and complete semantic correction in the actual note-writing step

incremental.description: Maintain clinical headings and inspect repeated transcription or drafting errors

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete clinician-checked actual assessment diagnosis treatment and response note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional 14-unit actual note-writing step retains 70 percent, saving 4.2 points minus one upkeep = 3.2. Half eligible notes gives 2.1 minus one = 1.1. Assessment, diagnosis, treatment and save retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Establish neurobehavioral baselines for monitoring disease progression or recovery.

steps.what: Review actual history and define the clinical question for longitudinal baseline measurement
Select appropriate neurobehavioral measures and establish valid administration conditions
Administer actual baseline measures and observe patient performance and limitations
Capture and check actual raw responses, timings, measure version and scoring inputs
Calculate specified baseline scores using validated version-matched scoring rules and norms
Interpret validity and write and check the actual baseline measures and clinical limitations
Save the checked actual neurobehavioral baseline record

tasks.design: Use licensed native deterministic scoring in {OTHER}, the assessment application, only for version-matched validated rules and norms. Keep measure choice, actual administration, raw-data capture, validity interpretation and substantive baseline writing human; separately save the checked baseline in the clinical record, also {OTHER}, without diagnosing progression from scores alone.
tasks.previous_blocker: Some actual measures may still require repeated raw-to-standard score calculation.
tasks.enabler_now: Validated native scoring can repeat explicit scoring rules without interpreting patient change.
tasks.still_hard: Validity, administration conditions and later longitudinal comparison require clinical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The clinician decides whether actual performance establishes a meaningful baseline.
tasks.altitude: Less score arithmetic; baseline validity and diagnostic decisions stay human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: licensed assessment applications can apply version-matched deterministic scoring rules and norm tables while clinical interpretation remains human.

assumptions: Boundary is establishing actual baseline measures and their clinical record. Later monitoring, change diagnosis and patient communication are not silently performed by a score calculation.

The clinician supplies actual raw responses, timings, patient context needed by the approved norm, measure version, administration date and limitations in s4. The publisher supplies validated scoring rules and licensed norms. Missing or incompatible inputs require manual scoring and validity assessment, not guessed conversions.

Native validated scoring is tested before custom work. No model scores free responses or selects norms. Only actual repeated arithmetic can lose time; existing automatic scoring and machine runtime earn no saving.
Shares are provisional. The existing baseline validity and writing accuracy work in s6 covers the final save; its fully retained 1 percent share is schema granularity.
unknowns: Current measures and licensed scoring coverage
research_questions: Does native scoring reproduce independently verified examples for the exact measures and norm versions used?

incremental.description: Check scoring-version changes and investigate incompatible input exceptions

approvals.approved_version: s6 complete checked actual baseline record with validity limits measure versions and source data

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional repeated scoring arithmetic saves ten points minus 1.5 upkeep = 8.5. Half eligible measures gives five minus 1.5 = 3.5. Actual assessment, measure choice, administration, input capture, clinical interpretation, writing and save retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less record navigation, discovery and specific documentation or score preparation; actual neuropsychological care and accountability remain human.
skills_to_grow: Verify semantic accuracy of actual clinical notes
Maintain source-linked clinical and literature views
role.ambitious_version: A clinician who spends less time on verified preparation while retaining direct patient assessment and professional judgement.
